clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-001.mp4
clips.transcript: Here is something that makes almost no sense.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-002.mp4
clips.transcript: By the summer of 1940, Nazi Germany had steamrolled

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-003.mp4
clips.transcript: steamrolled Poland, Denmark, Norway, Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, and France.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-004.mp4
clips.transcript: Hitler's armies were sitting in Paris.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-005.mp4
clips.transcript: Mussolini's divisions were pouring in from the south.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-006.mp4
clips.transcript: The Axis flag flew from the Baltic coast all the way down to the Mediterranean.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-007.mp4
clips.transcript: And if you drew a map of occupied Europe at that moment, you would see one tiny, inexplicable hole right in the middle.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-008.mp4
clips.transcript: middle. A country of around 4 million people, smaller than the state

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-009.mp4
clips.transcript: state of West Virginia,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-010.mp4
clips.transcript: completely surrounded on every single side by the most aggressive military machine the world had ever seen.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-011.mp4
clips.transcript: That country was Switzerland. And here's the strange part.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-012.mp4
clips.transcript: Hitler despised Switzerland. He called it a pimple on the face of Europe. His propaganda minister, Josef Goebbels, sneered at it as this stinking little state.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-013.mp4
clips.transcript: The Gestapo had already drawn up lists of Swiss politicians, journalists, Jews, and intellectuals to be arrested the moment German boots crossed the border.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-014.mp4
clips.transcript: Invasion plans existed. They had code names.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-015.mp4
clips.transcript: They had division counts, operational timetables, and maps drawn by some of the sharpest military minds in Europe.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-016.mp4
clips.transcript: And yet, for six long years of the most destructive war in human history,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-017.mp4
clips.transcript: not one Wehrmacht soldier ever crossed into Switzerland with

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-018.mp4
clips.transcript: with a rifle in anger.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-019.mp4
clips.transcript: For decades, the standard answer was simple. The Swiss got lucky, the mountains were too steep, or Hitler was too distracted by bigger prey. but none of those explanations hold up when you actually look at the evidence.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-020.mp4
clips.transcript: The real reason Hitler never invaded Switzerland is far stranger, far more cynical, and far more revealing about how modern power actually works than almost anyone realizes.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-021.mp4
clips.transcript: This is the story of the small Alpine country that stared down the Third Reich,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-022.mp4
clips.transcript: and the very uncomfortable deal that may have kept it alive. To understand why Hitler left Switzerland alone,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-023.mp4
clips.transcript: you first have to understand why he wanted to crush it so badly in the first place.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-024.mp4
clips.transcript: Switzerland was everything

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-025.mp4
clips.transcript: everything Nazi ideology hated.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-026.mp4
clips.transcript: It was a tiny confederation of 26 cantons that spoke four different languages, German, French, Italian, and Romance.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-027.mp4
clips.transcript: Its political system was built on compromise, direct democracy, and local autonomy. It had no king, no Führer, no single dominant race, no strong central ruler barking orders from a palace.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-028.mp4
clips.transcript: For a regime obsessed with blood, soil, racial purity, and total obedience,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-029.mp4
clips.transcript: obedience, the mere existence of Switzerland was a daily insult.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-030.mp4
clips.transcript: Here was a German-speaking democracy that refused to join the Reich, refused to persecute its citizens along ethnic lines, and refused to accept the Nazi worldview as inevitable.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-031.mp4
clips.transcript: Worse, Switzerland had become the most important refuge for anti-Nazi writers, politicians, and journalists in Europe.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-032.mp4
clips.transcript: The Swiss press tore into Hitler on a weekly basis.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-033.mp4
clips.transcript: German diplomats sent furious complaints to Berne about Swiss newspapers that mocked the Führer by name.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-034.mp4
clips.transcript: name. There were

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-035.mp4
clips.transcript: also powerful ideological reasons for Hitler to want the country gone.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-036.mp4
clips.transcript: He had grown up in Austria and considered all German-speaking peoples part of a greater Reich he was destined to unite.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-037.mp4
clips.transcript: In his view, the German-speaking cantons of Switzerland, which made up roughly two-thirds of the country, belonged to him by right of blood.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-038.mp4
clips.transcript: The plan was never about simple annexation. According to captured German documents, Switzerland was eventually to be dismembered. The German-speaking regions would be absorbed directly into the Reich. The French-speaking areas would be handed to Vichy France or carved up along linguistic lines. The Italian-speaking South, known as Ticino, would go to Mussolini. The country itself, as a political entity, would simply cease to exist.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-039.mp4
clips.transcript: Hitler said as much in private. In August 1942, he described Switzerland as a state that no longer had a right to exist.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-040.mp4
clips.transcript: All of the ingredients for an invasion were there. The hatred was real, the ideology demanded it,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-041.mp4
clips.transcript: and the military opportunity was staring

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-042.mp4
clips.transcript: staring him in the face.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-043.mp4
clips.transcript: face. The man who would eventually stand between Hitler and that dismemberment was not a politician or a king, but a 64-year-old officer named Henri Guisson.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-044.mp4
clips.transcript: On August 30, 1939, just two days before the German invasion of Poland,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-045.mp4
clips.transcript: the Swiss Federal Assembly took an extraordinary step. For only the fourth time in Swiss history, they activated the wartime rank of general and gave it to one man.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-046.mp4
clips.transcript: The vote was 204 out of 229, an overwhelming mandate from a country that normally hates concentrating power in any single individual.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-047.mp4
clips.transcript: Guissan was from the French-speaking canton of Vaux.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-048.mp4
clips.transcript: He was a career soldier, soft-spoken, modest, deeply religious, and known for his common touch.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-049.mp4
clips.transcript: He preferred farmhouses to palaces, and he spoke to his troops not as subjects, but as fellow citizens.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-050.mp4
clips.transcript: On the surface, he was not a thunderous warrior. He had no grand victories on his resume, no battlefield reputation, no fiery charisma.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-051.mp4
clips.transcript: charisma. What he did have was something Switzerland desperately needed in that moment, and that was moral authority.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-052.mp4
clips.transcript: The Swiss federal government in Bern in 1940 was riddled with hesitation. Some officials believed resistance was pointless.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-053.mp4
clips.transcript: Others whispered that accommodation with Berlin was the only realistic option.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-054.mp4
clips.transcript: There were even Swiss officers quietly sympathetic to Nazi ideas. In May 1940, Guisan personally ordered investigations into 124 army officers suspected of Nazi sympathies. He was not going to allow his command structure to rot from within.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-055.mp4
clips.transcript: But the greatest challenge was still to come. In the span of just six weeks that spring, the entire strategic situation collapsed.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-056.mp4
clips.transcript: Germany invaded Denmark and Norway

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-057.mp4
clips.transcript: Norway in April.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-058.mp4
clips.transcript: In May came the lightning assault on the Low

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-059.mp4
clips.transcript: Low Countries.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-060.mp4
clips.transcript: By June 22nd, 1940, France had surrendered.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-061.mp4
clips.transcript: Switzerland was now, for the first time in its modern history, completely encircled. There was no friendly border left. No supply line out. No corridor of escape. The country was effectively a prisoner inside the fortress of Nazi Europe, and the morale of the population was collapsing by the day.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-062.mp4
clips.transcript: What makes the pre-war picture even more remarkable is that German military

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-063.mp4
clips.transcript: military planners had been eyeing Switzerland since long

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-064.mp4
clips.transcript: long before 1940.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-065.mp4
clips.transcript: As early as March 1938, when Hitler

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-066.mp4
clips.transcript: Hitler was absorbing Austria into the Reich,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-067.mp4
clips.transcript: there was discussion in Berlin about rolling the operation straight across the Swiss border as a bonus.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-068.mp4
clips.transcript: bonus. According to historical accounts, Hitler himself personally blocked that idea on March 18, 1938,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-069.mp4
clips.transcript: specifically to avoid complicating relations with Switzerland at that moment. It was not mercy. It was timing.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-070.mp4
clips.transcript: He wanted Vienna first, Prague second, Warsaw third, and he did not want a forefront propaganda nightmare in the middle of his opening gambit.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-071.mp4
clips.transcript: The Swiss intelligence service, known as the Nachrichtendienst, picked up on these plans early and quietly began feeding information back to Bern.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-072.mp4
clips.transcript: Bern. Swiss diplomats were watching German troop movements. Swiss officers were studying Wehrmacht tactics in Poland and later in France.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-073.mp4
clips.transcript: By the time the fall of France arrived, Switzerland had already been wargaming the invasion of itself for years.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-074.mp4
clips.transcript: There is a crucial point here that often gets lost. Switzerland did not stumble into readiness.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-075.mp4
clips.transcript: It built readiness, patiently, for the better part of a decade, under successive defense ministers like Rudolf Minger,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-076.mp4
clips.transcript: Minger, who had already raised the Swiss defense budget from about 95 million francs to roughly 130 million within two years of Hitler's rise, and then went directly to the public in 1935 for an additional 235 million francs in defense bonds.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-077.mp4
clips.transcript: The country was arming itself in slow motion, while most of Europe was still trying to convince itself that peace was

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-078.mp4
clips.transcript: was possible. That is when Operation Tannenbaum began to take shape. The German High Command, known as the OKH, wasted no time.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-079.mp4
clips.transcript: time. Within hours of the French capitulation in June 1940, Captain Otto Wilhelm von Menges submitted the first draft plan for the invasion of Switzerland. It was initially called Fall Grün, or Case Green, and later renamed Tannenbaum, meaning Fir Tree.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-080.mp4
clips.transcript: Field Marshal Wilhelm Ritter von Leeb personally scouted the terrain,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-081.mp4
clips.transcript: driving along the border and studying possible invasion routes with the care of a man planning a hunting trip.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-082.mp4
clips.transcript: The plan went through multiple revisions. Early versions called for 11 German divisions attacking from the north, west, and east, with Italian divisions pushing up through the south.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-083.mp4
clips.transcript: Later versions pushed that number to 15 divisions, and eventually, by some counts, as many as 21 divisions were earmarked for the operation.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-084.mp4
clips.transcript: The German chief of staff, Franz Halder, wrote in his personal diary about Hitler's rage towards Switzerland and warned that at any moment the Führer's outbursts might trigger an actual order to attack.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-085.mp4
clips.transcript: The ideological war against Switzerland was also already underway.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-086.mp4
clips.transcript: underway. German newspapers ran articles about reunifying

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-087.mp4
clips.transcript: reunifying all German-speaking peoples.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-088.mp4
clips.transcript: peoples. German fifth columnists inside Switzerland were being quietly identified and activated. The Gestapo was preparing its blacklists.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-089.mp4
clips.transcript: Politically, the plan was clear. Switzerland would be partitioned along linguistic lines, its democracy dismantled, its Jews rounded up, and its name wiped off the map of Europe.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-090.mp4
clips.transcript: Militarily, the plan looked straightforward. The Swiss plateau, where most Swiss people live and where cities like Zurich, Bern, and Basel are located, is relatively flat and tank-friendly.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-091.mp4
clips.transcript: On paper, the Wehrmacht could have been in Bern within days.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-092.mp4
clips.transcript: Compared to the campaigns in Poland or France, Switzerland looked like an

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-093.mp4
clips.transcript: afternoon exercise.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-094.mp4
clips.transcript: And yet, the order never came.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-095.mp4
clips.transcript: Something was holding Hitler back. It was not laziness. It was not a strange soft spot.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-096.mp4
clips.transcript: The Führer, who had torn through Western Europe in six weeks, did not simply forget about the little country at the center of his new empire.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-097.mp4
clips.transcript: empire. What stopped him was a combination of three brutal realities that nobody fully appreciated at the time,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-098.mp4
clips.transcript: but which the Swiss had been quietly preparing for years in advance.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-099.mp4
clips.transcript: The first

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-100.mp4
clips.transcript: first of these realities began to crystallize in the summer of 1940 on a historic meadow called Ruecky. On July 25th, Guissan called every senior officer in the Swiss Army, roughly 650 commanders, to board a paddle steamer across Lake Lucerne.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-101.mp4
clips.transcript: Their destination was the Rutli Meadow, the legendary spot where in 1291 the

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-102.mp4
clips.transcript: the first three Swiss cantons were said to have sworn the oath that founded the Swiss Confederation.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-103.mp4
clips.transcript: The symbolism was enormous. Guissan was literally pulling his officer corps back to the birthplace of their nation to deliver a single, unforgettable message.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-104.mp4
clips.transcript: The country would never surrender. He outlined a radical new strategy called the Reduit National, or the National Redoubt.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-105.mp4
clips.transcript: It was the second brutal reality waiting for any invader. The idea was simple, but devastating in its implications.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-106.mp4
clips.transcript: In the event of a German attack, the Swiss army would not try to defend the border or even the major cities on the plateau. Instead, it would fight a delaying action, deliberately give up most of the country's territory and population, and then withdraw into a massive fortified bastion in the central Alps. The three anchors of this fortress were already in place or being built at breakneck speed, centered on the gigantic fortress complexes of Saint-Maurice to the west, Sargences to the east, and the Saint-Gothard massif in the middle. These were not symbolic bunkers. They were enormous subterranean complexes, miles of tunnels drilled directly into the mountain, with hospitals, kitchens, ammunition dumps, barracks, and heavy artillery pointed at every possible invasion route.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-107.mp4
clips.transcript: The Fort de Chillon, one of many such positions, remained operational until it was finally disarmed in 1995.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-108.mp4
clips.transcript: The strategy was adopted officially on July 12, 1940, and reinforced in Guissan's famous Rutli speech.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-109.mp4
clips.transcript: The message to Berlin was clear. If you invade us, you can have our cities.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-110.mp4
clips.transcript: You can have Zurich. You can have Basel. You can have Bern.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-111.mp4
clips.transcript: But you will never, ever get what you actually want from this country. because what you actually want is sitting under tons of granite in the Alps,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-112.mp4
clips.transcript: and we will fight you there until there is nothing left of either of us." And then, in case anyone missed the point, Guissan reportedly issued a now famous order to his men. Fight to your last cartridge, then fight with your bayonets. No surrender.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-113.mp4
clips.transcript: What the Germans also underestimated was the fact that Switzerland had already shown, in the opening weeks of the war, that its soldiers would actually fight. In the air battles of May and June 1940,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-114.mp4
clips.transcript: Swiss pilots flying their small force of Messerschmitt Bf 109 fighters, ironically purchased from Germany itself before the war,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-115.mp4
clips.transcript: engaged and shot down multiple Luftwaffe aircraft that strayed into Swiss airspace.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-116.mp4
clips.transcript: airspace. In a series of dogfights over Swiss territory,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-117.mp4
clips.transcript: the small Swiss air force downed at least 11 German planes, losing only a handful of their own.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-118.mp4
clips.transcript: Göring was furious. A diplomatic crisis erupted and Germany threatened reprisals.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-119.mp4
clips.transcript: The Swiss grounded their fighters temporarily and apologized diplomatically, but the message to Berlin had already landed. These were not symbolic forces. These were pilots who would open fire on the Luftwaffe. If Switzerland was willing to shoot down German planes over neutral airspace in peacetime, imagine what its soldiers would do when the invasion actually came.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-120.mp4
clips.transcript: The Swiss Army was not a parade regiment. It was a mobilization machine capable of putting an astonishing portion of its civilian population into uniform almost overnight.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-121.mp4
clips.transcript: By the time of the French collapse, Switzerland had mobilized around 430,000 men out of a population of just over 4 million, giving it one of the highest ratios of soldiers to civilians of any country on earth.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-122.mp4
clips.transcript: earth. Every Swiss male between 20 and 60 was required to keep a rifle, a uniform, and ammunition at home. The country was effectively a national militia, with mountains attached.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-123.mp4
clips.transcript: The third brutal reality was perhaps the most ingenious piece of psychological warfare any small country has ever pulled off.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-124.mp4
clips.transcript: If the Alpine fortress was Switzerland's shield, the country's transport infrastructure was its sword. And that sword was pointed directly at the heart of the Axis economy.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-125.mp4
clips.transcript: economy. Running right through the Swiss Alps are two of the most strategically important railway tunnels in all of Europe,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-126.mp4
clips.transcript: the Saint-Gothard Tunnel and the Simplon Tunnel. These were the arteries that connected Nazi Germany to its most important ally, Fascist Italy. Coal flowed south from the Ruhr to Italian factories. Trucks, machinery, and military supplies moved between the two Axis powers through those passes.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-127.mp4
clips.transcript: Without the Gotthard and Simplon, Germany and Italy would have been forced to send everything over longer, more exposed, and more vulnerable routes. The Swiss understood exactly what they were sitting on.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-128.mp4
clips.transcript: Beginning in 1940, under direct orders from the army, Switzerland quietly turned itself into one of the most heavily booby-trapped countries on earth.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-130.mp4
clips.transcript: Bridges, tunnels, mountain passes, roads, and railway lines were systematically wired with explosives.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-131.mp4
clips.transcript: By the peak of this doctrine during the Cold War, Switzerland had between 2,000 and 3,000 mine sites across its territory, many of them inherited directly from the Second World War.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-132.mp4

clips.transcript: proposing to blow up the Gotthard Tunnel along its entire 15 km length as a deterrent.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-134.mp4
clips.transcript: Even if his most dramatic proposal was never fully adopted, the broader principle absolutely was.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-135.mp4
clips.transcript: The Swiss made it crystal clear to the Germans, through diplomatic backchannels, that the moment a German division crossed the border,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-136.mp4
clips.transcript: the tunnels would go up. The passes would go up. The viaducts would go up.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-137.mp4
clips.transcript: The entire north-south lifeline through the Alps would be collapsed into a mountain of rubble that could take years to clear, if it could be cleared at all. And they would do it the night before, or the hour before, or the minute before, so that no lightning assault, no paratrooper raid, no fifth column could reach the demolition charges in time to stop them.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-138.mp4
clips.transcript: them. For a country totally dependent on the free flow of coal,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-139.mp4
clips.transcript: iron, and machinery through those passes, this was a catastrophic threat.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-140.mp4
clips.transcript: A functioning, neutral Switzerland was a vital transit route for Italy's war economy.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-141.mp4
clips.transcript: A conquered Switzerland would be a smoking crater right in the middle of the Axis supply chain.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-142.mp4
clips.transcript: That is the hostage strategy. Switzerland was not just defending itself.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-143.mp4
clips.transcript: It was holding Europe's economic circulatory system by the throat.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-144.mp4
clips.transcript: throat. But even granite fortresses and demolition charges would not have been enough on their own. because Hitler had broken through tougher defenses than those before.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-145.mp4
clips.transcript: What truly tipped the calculation in Switzerland's favor

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-146.mp4
clips.transcript: was the economic value of leaving the country intact.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-147.mp4
clips.transcript: And this is where the story takes its darkest turn.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-148.mp4
clips.transcript: turn. Switzerland was not simply a neutral bystander during the Second World

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-149.mp4
clips.transcript: World War.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-150.mp4
clips.transcript: it was the most important financial and industrial partner Nazi Germany ever had outside its own

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-151.mp4
clips.transcript: own borders. According to a 1997 United States government study, and the later Bergier Commission, a panel of historians commissioned by the Swiss government itself,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-152.mp4
clips.transcript: Switzerland was by far the most crucial economic relationship Nazi Germany maintained with any neutral country during the war.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-153.mp4
clips.transcript: The numbers are staggering. Over the course of the war, the Swiss National Bank bought an estimated 280 million US dollars worth of gold from the Nazi Weichsbank, which, in modern inflation-adjusted terms, would be worth roughly $2.5 billion. Private Swiss commercial banks bought an additional 61 million or more in gold,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-154.mp4
clips.transcript: much of it looted from the central banks of occupied countries like Belgium, the Netherlands,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-155.mp4
clips.transcript: and later from the victims of concentration camps through the infamous SS Melmer accounts. The Weichspank quite literally re-smelted gold stolen from murdered civilians, including gold fillings pulled from the teeth of Holocaust victims, into ingots that were indistinguishable from monetary gold,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-156.mp4
clips.transcript: and then shipped them to Switzerland to be converted into hard currency the Nazis could spend around the world. Switzerland became the laundromat of the Third Reich.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-157.mp4
clips.transcript: Without those Swiss francs, Germany could not have paid for strategic imports from Spain, Portugal, Turkey, and South America.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-158.mp4
clips.transcript: The Weichsmark was essentially worthless outside Nazi-controlled territory, but Swiss francs were accepted anywhere.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-159.mp4
clips.transcript: Every ingot smelted in Berlin and sent to Bern bought the German war machine another month of raw materials. And the gold was only one piece of it.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-160.mp4
clips.transcript: The industrial side of the relationship was just as damning, and just as vital to Hitler's calculations about whether to pull the trigger on Tannenbaum.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-161.mp4
clips.transcript: According to the Bergier Commission's findings, between 1940 and 1944, roughly 84% of Swiss munitions exports went to Axis countries.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-162.mp4
clips.transcript: Swiss factories produced precision weapons, anti-aircraft guns,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-163.mp4
clips.transcript: ammunition, fuses, and components that the Wehrmacht used on battlefields from North Africa to the Eastern Front.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-164.mp4
clips.transcript: Swiss companies manufactured locomotives, diesel engines, trucks, and machinery for the German war effort.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-165.mp4
clips.transcript: effort. The Oerlikon anti-aircraft cannon, a Swiss design, was deployed widely across the Axis forces.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-166.mp4
clips.transcript: Perhaps most critically of all, Swiss factories controlled a near monopoly on jewel bearings,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-167.mp4
clips.transcript: bearings, those tiny precision pivots essential for bombsights,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-168.mp4
clips.transcript: torpedo guidance systems, chronometers, and sensitive measuring instruments.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-169.mp4
clips.transcript: Without jewel bearings, modern aircraft and submarines could not function with precision.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-170.mp4
clips.transcript: precision.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-171.mp4
clips.transcript: Hitler simply could not afford to blow this supplier up.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-172.mp4
clips.transcript: And here is the crucial detail. Swiss

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-173.mp4
clips.transcript: industry was not just working for Germany out of necessity. In many cases, Switzerland was effectively subsidizing Nazi orders through a credit line called the clearing system. Under this arrangement, when Swiss factories delivered goods to Germany, the Swiss government paid the Swiss companies in Swiss francs up front. Germany then promised to repay Switzerland later through goods or gold under post-war settlement.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-174.mp4
clips.transcript: By the end of the war,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-175.mp4
clips.transcript: war, Switzerland was owed over 1 billion Swiss francs by Germany under this clearing mechanism, debts that were never fully repaid.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-176.mp4
clips.transcript: In effect, Switzerland was lending Hitler the money to buy his own weapons.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-177.mp4
clips.transcript: And that was perhaps the most important factor of all.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-178.mp4
clips.transcript: A functioning, cooperative, trading Switzerland was far more valuable to the Nazi war machine than a conquered, bombed,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-179.mp4
clips.transcript: bombed, booby-trapped Switzerland would ever have been.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-180.mp4
clips.transcript: If Hitler invaded, the gold laundering stops. The jewel bearings stop. The munitions stop. The trucks stop. The clearing credits stop.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-181.mp4
clips.transcript: stop. The Gotthard and Simplon tunnels collapse into dust.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-182.mp4
clips.transcript: And in exchange, Germany gains a mountainous rubble pile that would need to be garrisoned by divisions that Hitler desperately needed on the Eastern Front,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-183.mp4
clips.transcript: fighting an angry Swiss population that had promised to resist to the last cartridge.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-184.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-185.mp4
clips.transcript: The real reason Hitler never invaded Switzerland was that Switzerland

clips.transcript: was worth more to him alive than dead. There is one more institution that belongs in this picture, because without it, the whole machine would not have worked quite as smoothly. In the city of Basel, right on the border with Germany and France,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-187.mp4
clips.transcript: sits a strange and powerful institution called the Bank for International Settlements, or the BIS.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-188.mp4
clips.transcript: Founded in 1930, originally to handle German war reparations from the First World War,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-189.mp4
clips.transcript: the BIS had quietly transformed into the Central Bank of Central Banks, a place where the heads of national monetary authorities quietly settled debts with each other.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-190.mp4
clips.transcript: other. During the Second World War, the BIS continued operating, with an American president named Thomas McKittrick at its head.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-191.mp4
clips.transcript: It kept doing business for Nazi Germany throughout the war.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-192.mp4
clips.transcript: It accepted Nazi gold deposits. It cleared transactions on behalf of the Reichsbank.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-193.mp4
clips.transcript: And it did all this from the safety of neutral Switzerland,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-194.mp4
clips.transcript: with representatives from both Allied and Axis central banks sitting on its board at the same time. Historians have debated exactly how much of this was unavoidable technical housekeeping, and how much was active collaboration.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-195.mp4
clips.transcript: But the picture that emerged after the war was ugly enough that the Americans at Bretton Woods in 1944 actually passed a resolution calling for the BIS to be dissolved.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-196.mp4
clips.transcript: That resolution was ultimately ignored, and the BIS still exists today in Basel, more powerful than ever.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-197.mp4
clips.transcript: During the war itself, however, its presence on Swiss soil added yet another layer to the argument that Switzerland was too valuable to disturb.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-198.mp4
clips.transcript: The country was not just a bank and an arms factory. It was the physical nerve center of the global financial system.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-199.mp4
clips.transcript: And even Hitler, for all his contempt, understood that smashing that nerve center would ricochet through the entire wartime economy in ways no one could predict.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-200.mp4
clips.transcript: That calculation was reinforced by Switzerland's willingness to adjust its neutrality in ways that benefited Berlin whenever the pressure got high enough.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-201.mp4
clips.transcript: The Swiss government and the Swiss military intelligence service were masters of what one historian has called cold accommodation.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-202.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-204.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-205.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-206.mp4
clips.transcript: Under the Anglo-American-Swiss War Trade Agreement signed on March 8, 1945, Switzerland finally agreed that the Swiss-German Trade Agreement, which had lapsed on February 15, 1945, would not be renewed,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-207.mp4
clips.transcript: and that strict new limits would be placed on exports of coal,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-208.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-209.mp4
clips.transcript: materials. But by then, the war was essentially

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-210.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-211.mp4
clips.transcript: For most of the conflict, Switzerland had operated as a critical economic lifeline for both sides,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-212.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-213.mp4
clips.transcript: pressure. The Swiss made darker compromises as well.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-214.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-215.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-216.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-217.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-218.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-219.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-220.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-222.mp4
clips.transcript: So why did Hitler not invade when he had every opportunity? Because the Swiss had turned themselves into a terrible investment. The combination of all three factors created a wall that no rational military planner could justify breaking through.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-223.mp4
clips.transcript: through. First, the Redouit strategy guaranteed that even if the Wehrmacht took the plateau in a matter of days, as German planners calculated they would,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-224.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-225.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-226.mp4
clips.transcript: Second, the demolition charges on the Gotthard and Simplon tunnels, and the thousands of other mine sites across the country, meant that the strategic prize of controlling Swiss transit routes would be destroyed the moment German troops crossed the border, denying Hitler the very thing an invasion would be designed to secure.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-227.mp4
clips.transcript: Third, and most decisively, Switzerland was worth staggeringly more to the Reich as a functioning financial laundromat and arms supplier than it ever could have been as another occupied territory.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-228.mp4
clips.transcript: And the Nazi leadership knew it. Hermann Göring himself reportedly argued against invading Switzerland for exactly these economic reasons.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-229.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-230.mp4
clips.transcript: Hitler apparently told his inner circle that he could always invade Switzerland later, after everything else was done.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-231.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-232.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-233.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-234.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-237.mp4
clips.transcript: There is

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-239.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-246.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-247.mp4

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-248.mp4
clips.transcript: The last gasp of Nazi aggression towards Switzerland was quietly suffocated by a joint operation of Italian partisans and Swiss spies.

clips.transcript: The Vaudouille was a brilliant piece of military strategy.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-258.mp4
clips.transcript: The Swiss soldiers who stood guard on those mountain passes were not actors. They were ready to fight and die for their homeland, and the Germans knew it.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-259.mp4
clips.transcript: But the fuller picture, the one that emerged slowly through the Bergier Commission reports, the U.S. State Department Eisenstadt Report of 1997, and decades of patient archival research, is far more complicated.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-260.mp4
clips.transcript: Switzerland survived the Second World War not through heroism alone,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-261.mp4
clips.transcript: alone, but through a cold,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-262.mp4
clips.transcript: cold, pragmatic bargain.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-263.mp4
clips.transcript: It made itself militarily too expensive to conquer.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-264.mp4
clips.transcript: It made itself economically too valuable to destroy.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-265.mp4
clips.transcript: And in doing so, it crossed moral lines that it would spend the next half century trying to come to terms with.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-266.mp4
clips.transcript: The arms exports, the laundered gold, the refugees turned back at the border, the clearing credits that effectively financed Hitler's purchases, all of it belongs to the story.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-267.mp4
clips.transcript: The real reason Hitler never invaded Switzerland is not that he was afraid of the Alps.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-268.mp4
clips.transcript: It is that Switzerland had,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-269.mp4
clips.transcript: had, with calculated precision, made itself indispensable to the very regime that wanted to erase it.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-270.mp4
clips.transcript: There is a hard lesson in all of this about how small countries actually survive great powers.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-271.mp4
clips.transcript: Sometimes it is not through courage alone, and not through moral purity, and certainly not through luck.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-272.mp4
clips.transcript: Sometimes it is through making yourself so inconvenient to kill that even the most ruthless predator decides it is cheaper to keep you around.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-273.mp4
clips.transcript: around. Switzerland in the Second World War is one of the clearest examples of that logic ever recorded.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-274.mp4
clips.transcript: The country emerged from the war with its democracy intact,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-275.mp4
clips.transcript: its economy booming, its borders unviolated,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-276.mp4
clips.transcript: and its hands not entirely clean.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-277.mp4
clips.transcript: The gold vaults in Zurich grew fatter during

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-278.mp4
clips.transcript: during the war than at any other point in Swiss history.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-279.mp4
clips.transcript: The country that had spent the previous six years surrounded by the swastika would spend the next 60 years as the global capital of discrete wealth. And the uncomfortable truth is that those two facts are not unrelated.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-280.mp4
clips.transcript: The Swiss banking system that quietly accepted Nazi gold in 1943 was the same system that would, by the 1960s and 1970s, become the preferred vault for dictators, oligarchs, and tax evaders from every continent.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-281.mp4
clips.transcript: The institutional habits of looking the other way, of asking no questions, of valuing confidentiality above almost everything else, were forged and perfected during exactly those war years.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-282.mp4
clips.transcript: years. So when you look at the map of Europe in 1942 and see that one small untouched hole in the middle of Nazi territory, remember what you are actually looking at. You are not looking at an accident of geography or a quirk of history.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-283.mp4
clips.transcript: You are looking at the result of a very deliberate strategy, executed over many years by people who understood exactly what kind of enemy they were dealing with.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-284.mp4
clips.transcript: You are looking at a country that built the most impressive mountain fortresses in Europe,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-285.mp4
clips.transcript: wired its own infrastructure with enough explosives to collapse the continent's supply chains, and simultaneously made itself the one banker and arms dealer in Europe that even Adolf Hitler could not afford to shut down.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-286.mp4
clips.transcript: The real reason Hitler never invaded Switzerland is not a feel-good story about plucky underdogs.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-287.mp4
clips.transcript: It is a story about the limits of raw power, the

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-288.mp4
clips.transcript: the ruthless mathematics of economic interdependence,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-289.mp4
clips.transcript: and the moral cost of survival in a world on fire.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-290.mp4
clips.transcript: It is a story about how neutrality, when wielded with enough strategic intelligence and enough moral flexibility,

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-291.mp4
clips.transcript: flexibility, can be a weapon as powerful as any tank division.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-292.mp4
clips.transcript: Switzerland is still here. The Reich is not.

clips.source: /Users/ilia/Downloads/The Real Reason Hitler Never Invaded Switzerland - Clips/Clip-293.mp4
clips.transcript: And every franc that moves through the vaults of Zurich today still carries, somewhere deep in its DNA, the fingerprints of the bargain that was struck when the swastika flew on every side of the Alps.
